JRDSU Admission 2026 Online Form - Complete Details

JRDSU Admission 2026 Online Form. Eligible candidates can apply online through the official website before the last date. The last date to apply is 20/06/206. Check important dates, application fee, eligibility criteria and official links below.

Important Dates

  • Start Date : 20/04/2026
  • Last Date : 20/06/206
  • Last Date Pay Fees : 20/06/2026
  • Late Fee Last Date : 15/07/2026

Application Fee

  • Start Date : 20/04/2026
  • Last Date : 20/06/206
  • Last Date Pay Fees : 20/06/2026
  • Late Fee Last Date : 15/07/2026
  • All Category Fee : Course Wise Fee
  • Post Graduate Course : Bachelor Degree Passed from any Recognized University in India.

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
